 Early Vote Dates, Locations Set for Craighead County Dec. 1 Runoff Election
 The dates and locations for early voting in the December runoff election for Craighead County have been set. 
 By Rachel Rudd November 17, 2026 8:05 am 
 Facebook 
 X 
 More 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 SMS 
 Jonesboro Right Now 
 Craighead County, AR – Jonesboro Right Now – The dates and locations for early voting in the December runoff election for Craighead County have been set. 
 Early voting is set for Nov. 24, 25, 27 and 30, with polls to be open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Election Day is Dec. 1, with polls to be open 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. 
 Early voting locations will be the Craighead County Election Annex, located at 315 W. Jefferson Ave. in Jonesboro, and the Lake City Eastern Annex, located at 113 Cobean Blvd. in Lake City. 
 |  ADD US ON GOOGLE NEWS:  Click here to see more local news from Jonesboro Right Now 
 Election Day voting in Jonesboro will take place at Valley View Church of Christ, located at 4500 Southwest Drive. Election Day voting in Lake City will still take place at the Eastern Annex.
 Voters are headed back to the polls to vote in the runoff elections for Ward 5, Position 1 of the Jonesboro City Council, and for Lake City mayor. 
 | PREVIOUSLY: ELECTION WRAP-UP: Safety Tax Fails, Massive Shakeup on Quorum Court, Runoffs Set 
 According to election results , in the Nov. 3 general election for Jonesboro city council, incumbent L.J. Bryant received 38% of the vote, challenger Patti Lack took 29%, Vince Pearcy secured 23%, and James Carl Wilson, Jr. finished with 10%. Bryant and Lack will face off in the runoff.
 In the Lake City mayoral race, Daniel Haynes finished with 38% and Jackie Davis took 36%. Incumbent Mayor Cameron Tate finished third with 26%. Haynes and Davis will meet in the runoff.
 Click here to view a sample ballot. 
 Jonesboro Right Now will provide complete coverage of these runoff races , including live election night results.
